## The defect

`DashboardGridLayout.datasetPath.test.tsx` makes a **real network call** — same ECONNREFUSED-on-port-3000 signature as #5225 / #5280, different file. Reproduces 3/3 in isolation (1 attempt; all 13 tests still pass, which is exactly why nothing catches it). Confirmed independent of `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` (present with that file removed from the directory).

This is the escape that explains the stray `invoices` request in #5280's original capture — #5280's own fix could not have produced it, because `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` has no `invoices` fixture.

## The fix shape is established — port it, don't reinvent

#5283 established the shape and #5280 ported it once already:
- a **recording double** answering the metadata probe,
- an `afterEach` that **fails on any non-metadata escape**,
- `cleanup()` before `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` **in the same afterEach** — #5280 measured that the LIFO reverse-registration order is a real flake source here.

Read #5280's merged diff (PR #5300) and follow it. A second, independently-written version of the same harness is the defect shape this repo keeps paying for.

## The actual work item

Per triage: **the `-t` bisect to pin the exact case and call site.** The card scopes it. Do that first — a blanket double added without knowing which case escapes would silence the symptom without proving what caused it, and would not tell you whether one escape or several exist.

The card names two candidates (the legacy `options.data.provider:'object'` object-chart path, and the `isLegacyRetiredWidget` sentinel path) and notes that **neither mock result declares `object` on the `queryDataset` payload, so `useDatasetDimensionMeta`'s own guard should not be the site** — treat that as a previous round's reading to re-verify, not as fact.

## Verification

- Run the file **in isolation, repeatedly** (the card reproduces 3/3) — before and after. Report the ECONNREFUSED count both ways; "0 escapes" needs the pre-fix non-zero count beside it to mean anything.
- Confirm the full package run stays green.
- **Reverse-verify**: revert with the pin kept, predict what goes red, report predicted-vs-observed. A swallowed side effect is not a wrong assertion — if the pre-existing tests stay green on both legs, say so plainly (that is the whole reason this bug survived).
- ⛔ Run vitest **from the repository root**. Do not rely on `assertCanonicalVitestInvocation` to catch a package-cwd run — measured today (objectui#5313) to NOT cover the 11 packages owning a standalone `vitest.config.ts`, contrary to its docstring.
- Counter-probe every zero with a known-present neighbouring term.

Changeset: judge with `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (test-only changes usually owe none). ⛔ **NEVER declare `major`**.
⛔ Do not edit `content/docs/releases/`, `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`.
